reason: I forget my pills at home every time I travel, and one sachet in the gym bag fixes that. The named lab and a report per batch answers my 'is it really tested' question, so I'd try one box at the launch price.
objection: A lab report on their own product page could still be cherry-picked. I'd want to check that the lab is a real one and that the report matches the batch number on my box.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report turned out to be missing, vague, or not tied to the batch on the box, I would not buy.
